I have been here since Monday.

facts.label: Present perfect com for e since
facts.sub: Use have/has + particípio. For + período de tempo (for ten years); since + início (since 1990). Pergunta: How long has she lived here?

facts.label: Por / há (período)
facts.sub: Use for com um período de tempo: for ten years, for two weeks, for an hour. Exemplo: She has lived here for forty years. Responde a quanto tempo.

facts.label: Desde (início)
facts.sub: Use since com um ponto de partida: since 1990, since Monday, since last spring. Exemplo: Her shop has been here since 1990.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: For is used with a period of time.
Since is used with a starting point.
We say “She lives here since ten years.”
items.why: We say has lived here for ten years.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: For is used with a period of time. → Verdadeiro (For ten years.)
Since is used with a starting point. → Verdadeiro (Since 1990.)
We say “She lives here since ten years.” → Falso (We say has lived here for ten years.)

pages.title: A quiet Dublin street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a gray Saturday afternoon on a quiet street in Dublin. Small houses stand in a long row, and every door looks familiar. Dean walks slowly and looks at each door. His friend Paulo is new in the city. They stop in front of a red house. Dean points at the window.

“Paulo, do you see that red house? Mrs. Brown has lived there for forty years.” says Dean. “Forty years! She has known this street since before my parents were born.” says Paulo. “Yes. Her shop has been on the corner since 1990.” says Dean.
